comparison.objective: Place a non-slip mat beneath a heavy bowl without spilling; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tips and steadies a 1.2 kg bowl while inserting a mat underneath. Candidate performs recessed-tool access, collar adjustment, relocking, and guarded test actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR limits bowl tilt to 30° and foot motion to 4 cm, then requires a level bowl on the mat. Candidate requires repeated non-bottoming impacts within energy, force, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Bimanual support-and-underlay insertion does not test fine fastener access or closed-loop dynamic damping adjustment.
